original_description: Fast, rigorous in-chat visualisations for advanced mathematics - abstract algebra (groups, Cayley graphs, subgroup lattices, quotient groups, field extensions and towers, Galois), complex analysis (complex plane, conformal maps, domain colouring, Cauchy integral theorem, residues, contours), geometry and geometric algebra, functional analysis (Hahn-Banach, Riesz representation, norms and unit balls, projections, operators), graphs and graph algorithms, commutative diagrams and proof-structure diagrams, and STEM beyond pure maths (ODE phase portraits and equilibria, probability distributions and the central limit theorem, electric fields, projectile motion, RLC/RC circuits, thin-lens optics). Use whenever the user asks to visualise, draw, picture, sketch, plot, illustrate or "show me" any such concept, or is learning/revising a theorem or proof and a diagram would help, even if they never say "visualisation". Output is inline SVG / Mermaid in chat (JSXGraph only when dragging teaches), never slow renders.
